decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (1617-101253-001 Rev P2 & 1617-101253-002 Rev P1, received on 05/03/2018;
1617-101253-003 Rev P1, 1617-101253-002 Rev P2, 1617-101253-003 Rev P, 1617-101253-004 Rev P1, 1617-101253-005 Rev P1, 1617-101253-006 Rev P1, 1617-101253-007 Rev P1, 1617-101253-008 Rev P1, 1617-101253-009 Rev P1,1617-101253-010 Rev P1, 1617-101253-011 Rev P1, 1617-101253-012 Rev P1, 1617-101253-013 Rev P1, 1617-101253-014 Rev P1, 1617-101253-015 Rev P1, 1617-101253-016 Rev P1, Unnumbered Proposed Window and Door Specification & Unnumbered Proposed Communal Door Specification) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
description: Replacement of existing aluminium framed single glazed windows and internal secondary glazing with uPVC framed double glazed top hung casement windows & replacement of existing aluminium framed door set with new aluminium framed door sets.
